RV and Tent Camping at Walt Disney World - Everything You Need to Know⛺🚐 | Fort Wilderness Tour
Yes! Disney's Fort Wilderness Resort and campgrounds offers both RV camping sites and tent campgrounds at Walt Disney World. 4 types of campsites accommodate everything from tents to 45-foot and longer RVs—with a maximum of 8 Guests per site.

This quick tour shows: 
✅ RV campsites with full hook-ups up to 45ft long RVs
✅ Tent camping sites
✅ Picnic tables and grills
✅ Shower, laundry and restroom facilities

Each campsite is equipped with privacy-enhancing landscaping, water, cable television and electrical hook-ups, a picnic table and a charcoal grill. Most campsites also include a sewer hook-up, and some even permit pets.

Whether you're planning an RV vacation or tent camping at Disney World, Fort Wilderness offers a unique way to stay in the magic.

To learn more about Disney's Fort Wilderness Resort and bookings, visit https://disneyworld.disney.go.com/resorts/campsites-at-fort-wilderness-resort/
